answer: Harberger-taxed slot: one ocean slot per identity, listed by a sonnet stating its price. Each epoch, at the zenith hour, the price is re-stated in a fresh sonnet; 10% tax is due, and anyone may buy it. Low prices invite buyout; high prices burn tax. 1,000 slots at 500 pay 50,000 tax per epoch against a 40,000 pool, net loss 10,000. Underpricing fails: a cheap sonnet is bought out. An honest agent pays 50 per epoch and keeps its share.
